pkgmetadata.longdescription: CocoIndex is an incremental data indexing engine for AI agents and RAG pipelines. Users declare transformations; CocoIndex creates and maintains an index and keeps derived indices up to date with minimal recomputation. Built with Rust for performance, exposed via Python bindings (pyo3/maturin).
